rationale: The current 8.8 aggregate Premier Cloud row gives Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The 8.8 task gives Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, enabled assistant and paired SOAR. The task also retains eligible existing findings, the first ten per detection burst, approximately 200 per tenant daily, frontier models and inherited SOAR connector/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task retains its historical AI SOC Analyst identity. Cloud Connected CMP lists Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; the current ES overview calls for SAIA 2.4+, while the Cloud Connected 2.3.6 installation guide and SAIA-9918 still exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6 and offer 2.1.1 without Agent Mode. The public planned 2.4 path remains unestablished. The ES regional table and release stage do not establish exact SOAR pairing, per-agent rollout, component entitlement or customer authorization.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
